integrity: Proof and independently reproducible finite rational checks are included. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact real-zero/multiplicity and density classification for one strictly positive symmetric triadic digit-weight parameter. No complex-zero or Fourier-basis classification, no parameter-uniform errors; older general self-similar Fourier literature carries priority risk.
title: Arithmetic multiplicity and popcorn density of Fourier zeros for symmetric triadic digit measures
